

local function __d(b,k)
  local alpha='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
  local kk={}
  for i=1,#k,2 do kk[#kk+1]=tonumber(k:sub(i,i+1),16) end
  local bin={}
  local i=1
  while i<=#b do
    local c1=alpha:find(b:sub(i,i),1,true) or 1
    local c2=alpha:find(b:sub(i+1,i+1),1,true) or 1
    local c3=alpha:find(b:sub(i+2,i+2),1,true) or 1
    local c4=alpha:find(b:sub(i+3,i+3),1,true) or 1
    local n=(c1-1)*262144+(c2-1)*4096+(c3-1)*64+(c4-1)
    bin[#bin+1]=math.floor(n/65536)%256
    if b:sub(i+2,i+2)~='=' then bin[#bin+1]=math.floor(n/256)%256 end
    if b:sub(i+3,i+3)~='=' then bin[#bin+1]=n%256 end
    i=i+4
  end
  local r={}
  local xb
  if bit32 and bit32.bxor then
    xb = bit32.bxor
  else
    xb = function(a,c)
      local res,bit=0,1
      while a>0 or c>0 do
        local ab,ac=a%2,c%2
        if ab~=ac then res=res+bit end
        a=math.floor(a/2); c=math.floor(c/2); bit=bit*2
      end
      return res
    end
  end
  for j=1,#bin do
    local kb=kk[((j-1)%#kk)+1] or 0
    r[j]=string.char(xb(bin[j],kb))
  end
  return table.concat(r)
end
